title: A theme of the Zinc Discord client
description: Put the file in the app's themes folder (Settings, Appearance, Open the themes folder) and choose it in Settings. A colour left out takes Discord's own (dark or light, by scheme).

name.description: Shown in Settings; the file name when missing.

scheme.description: The base: the colours left out, and the switches and sliders of Settings.

rail.description: The server rail on the left; the background of menus and spoilers.

sidebar.description: The channel list, the member list, embeds and code blocks.

footer.description: Your name and the call bar under the channel list.

input.description: The message box and the fields.

hover.description: A channel or a button under the pointer.

rowHover.description: A message under the pointer, or the one you reply to or edit.

selected.description: The open channel, the chosen tab.

border.description: The outline of cards, files and code blocks.

faint.description: Quote bars, quiet buttons, empty poll bars.

muted.description: Secondary text: times, read channels, hints; the icons of the sidebar.

strong.description: Names, headers, unread channels, timestamps in messages.

icon.description: The icons of message actions and attachments.

mention.description: Mentions of users, channels and roles in the text.

accent.description: Buttons, the chosen server, your reactions, avatars without a picture.

danger.description: Delete and other buttons that destroy.

badge.description: The count of mentions; do not disturb.

accentText.description: Text and icons on the accent: buttons, push to talk.

success.description: Online, speaking, Voice Connected, a good connection.

stage.description: The call view behind the tiles (a dark surface: its text is white).

stageTile.description: A participant's tile and the round buttons of the call.

sidebarText.description: Channels you have read in the channel list and the user bar; the text colour when left out.

sidebarMuted.description: Categories, icons and the unread-free text of the channel list; the muted colour when left out.

sidebarStrong.description: The server name, unread channels, your name and the server rail's initials; the strong colour when left out.

sidebarHover.description: A channel or a button of the channel list under the pointer; the hover colour when left out.

sidebarSelected.description: The open channel in the channel list; the selected colour when left out.

surface.description: Cards, code blocks, popovers and the settings' menu; the sidebar colour when left out.

sidebarSelectedText.description: The text of the open channel in the channel list; the strong colour when left out.

radius.description: px of the rounded corners of the message box and code blocks.

font.description: A font family the app ships (assets/<Family>.ttf) for messages; empty for the default.

textSize.description: px of the text of messages.

composerBorder.description: An outline around the message box (Slack's).
